chapter.verse: Tua nung ciangin Zeisu in Tiberias tuili kici, Galile tuili gal khatah a pai hi.
Cinate tungah a lamdang lim a lahna a mu mihonpite in a nung a zui uh hi.
Zeisu mual tungah kahto a, a nungzuite tawh a tukhawm hi.
Tua lai takin Judah mite’ Paisan pawikham hun a nai zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Zeisu in a khuadak leh mihonpite ama kiangah hong pai a muh ciangin Filip kiangah, “Hih mite nek ding khomun bang lak pan i lei ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Tua bang a dotna in bang hang hiam i cih leh, amah in bangci a bawl ding thei napi-in Filip ze-etna bekin a dong hi.
Filip in, “Mi a vekpi-in themkha khat tek a ngah nadingun dangka zanih man khomun a cing kei ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Simon Piter’ nau Andru a kici ama nungzui khat in,
“Hihsan takah khomun pum nga leh nganeu tawn nih a nei naupang khat a om hi. Ahih hangin mi hizah tak a tam lakah hih khomun leh ngasa nih in bang tham hi ding hiam?” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Mite na tusak un,” a ci hi. Tua munah lopa tampi a om hi. Amaute sim le-hang pasal tul nga bang a tu uh hi.
Zeisu in khomun la a, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin a tute lakah a hawmsak hi. Tua mah bangin ngasa zong mite’ deih zahzahin a hawm uh hi.
Amaute in a kham khit uh ciangin Zeisu in, “Bang mah a man’ loh nadingin khamval teng tawm kik un,” ci-in a nungzuite thu a pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, khomun pum nga panin an nete’ khamval a neng a themte a top uh ciangin, seeng sawm leh seeng nih dim a ngah uh hi.
Tua bangin Zeisu in nalamdang a bawl tua mite in a muh uh ciangin, “Hih pa in leitungah hong pai ding Pasian’ kamsangpa taktak ahi hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tuate hong pai-in Topa kumpipa-a koih nadingin a hahbawl ding uh cih Zeisu in a theih ciangin, mual tungah amah guak a kahto kik hi.
Nitak ciangin a nungzuite tuili-ah paisuk uh a,
gunkuang ah tuangin Kapernaum khua tung dingin a pai uh hi. Tua lai takin khua miala Zeisu amaute kiang a hong tung nai kei hi.
Huih nakpi nung ahih ciangin tui a kilok hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, tai nih tai thum bang a hot khit uh ciangin, Zeisu tuili tungah pai a, gunkuang hong naih a muh uh ciangin a lau uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Keimah ka hi hi, lau kei un,” a cih ciangin,
lungdamin Topa gunkuang tungah a la uh a; gunkuang in amau pai nopna lei thakhatin a tun’ hi.
Zingsang ciangin, tuili gal khatah a ding mihonpite in gunkuang khat longal gunkuang dang a mu kei uh hi.
Amau in khomun a nekna phual uh tawh kinai Tiberias khua pan gunkuangte hong tung uh hi. Zeisu in a nungzuite tawh tua gunkuang sungah lut khawm loin, a nungzuite bek a pai uh a mu uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuasan takah Zeisu ahi zongin, a nungzuite ahi zongin a om loh uh mihonpite in a theih uh ciangin, amau zong gunkuang tungah tuangin Zeisu zong dingin Kapernaum khua-ah a pai uh hi.
Tuili gal khatah Zeisu a muh uh ciangin amaute in, “Rabbi aw, cik a, hih lai-ah hong tung na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, note in nalamdang na muh manun kei hong zong na hi kei uh hi; khomun na ne uh a, na kham uh ciangin hong zong na hi uh hi.

A sia thei an ngah nadingin hahkat kei un; Mihing Tapa in no hong piak ahing tawntung nuntak tawntungna an na ngah nadingun hahkat un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ ciamtehna a ngahpa in tua Tapa ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tuate in, “Pasian’ na ka sep theih nadingun bangci ka hih ding uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Pasian hong sawlpa upna in Pasian nasepna ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, amau in, “Topa aw, kong muh uh a, kong up na’ngun nalamdang bang hong lak na hi hiam? Bang hong bawl ding na hi hiam?
Vantung panin khomun a mau nek ding a pia hi ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh bangin, i pute i pate in gampa lakah khomun a ne uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, vantung pan khomun a piapa in Moses ahi kei hi; ka Pa in vantung khomun taktak note hong pia hi.
Pasian’ khomun in vantung pan hong paisuk a, leitung mite nuntakna a pia khomun ahi hi,” a cih leh,
“Topa aw, tua khomun ko hong pia tawntung in,” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Keimah in nuntakna khomun ka hi hi. Kei kiangah hong pai mi in a nung ciangin a gilkial ngei nawn kei ding hi. Kei hong um mi in a nung ciangin a dangtak nawn kei ding hi.
Ahih hangin note in kei hong mu napi-in nong um kei uh hi kong ci zo hi.
Pa in kei hong piakte khempeuh kei kiangah hong pai ding uh hi. Ka kiangah hong pai mite ka hawlkhia ngei kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keima deih bangin gamta dingin vantung pan hong kumsuk ka hi kei hi; kei hong sawlpa’ deihna bang gamta dingin hong kumsuk ka hi hi.
Kei hong sawlpa’ deihna in kei hong piak mite khempeuh khat beek ka man’suah loh nadingin Ni tawp ni ciangin ka thokik sak ding hi.
Tapa mu a, a umte khempeuh in nuntak tawntungna a ngah nading in Pa’ deihna ahi hi,” a ci hi.
“Vantung pan hong kumsuk khomun ka hi hi,” Zeisu in a cih ciangin
Judah mite in, “Hih pa in Josef’ tapa Zeisu hilo ahi hiam? A nu leh pa thei hilo i hi hiam? Tua ahih leh, ‘Vantung pan kong paisuk zo hi,’ bang hangin ci thei hiam?” ci-in a gensia uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Khat leh khat in hong gensia kei un.
Kei hong sawl Pa in a sawl kei leh, kuamah in ka kiangah hong pai thei kei hi. Keimah in ni tawp Ni ciangin tua mi ka thosak ding hi.
‘Pasian in tuate a hilh ding hi,’ ci-in Pasian’ kamsangte’ lai sungah a kigelh hi. Pa kiangah thu ngai a, a kisin mite khempeuh keima kiangah hong pai uh hi.
Tua bang ka cih ciangin, Pasian kiang pan hong paipa longal mi khat beek in Pasian a mu zo hi ka cihnopna ahi kei hi.
Vantung pan hong paipa in Pa a mu zo hi. Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, a hong umte in nuntak tawntungna a nei uh hi.
Nuntakna khomun ka hi hi.
Na pute na pate un gampa lakah khomun a ne uh a, a si uh hi.
Vantung pan hong kumsuk hih khomun a nete in sihna tawh a kipelh ding hi.

Keimah in vantung pan hong kumsuk nuntakna khomun ka hi hi. Hih khomun a nete in a tawntungin a nungta ding hi. Ahi hi. Ka hong piak khomun in leitung mite’ nuntak nading ka piak ka sa ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mite in, “Hih pa in ama sa nek dingin bangci hong piak thei ding ahi hiam?” ci-in khat leh khat a kiseel uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, Mihing Tapa’ sa ne-in a si na dawn kei uh leh, note sungah nuntakna a om kei ding hi.
Keima sa ne a, ka si a dawnte in nuntak tawntungna a nei uh hi. Ni tawp ni ciangin tua mi ka thokiksak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka sa in an taktak ahi hi; ka si in dawn ding taktak ahi hi.
Ka sa ne a, ka si a dawnte in kei sungah om a, ama sungah kei ka om ding hi.
A nungta Pa in hong sawl a, Pa hangin ka nuntak mah bangin, keimah hong nete in kei hangin a nungta ding hi.
Hih khomun in vantung pan hong kumsuk khomun ahi hi. Pute pate in khomun ne-in a si uh bang hi loin, hih khomun a nete in a nungta tawntung ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Kapernaum khua-ah kikhopna inn sungah Zeisu in a hilh lai takin hih thu teng a gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, ama nungzui tampite in hih thu a zak uh ciangin, “Hih thu a haksa mahmah hi, kua in theitel zo ding ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zeisu in tua thu hangin ah a nungzuite in a phunpihna thu a sin sungah a theih ciangin, “Hih thu in note hong puksak hiam?
Mihing Tapa in ama omna ngeiah a kahtokik na muh uh ciangin, bangci na ngaihsun ding uh hiam?
Nuntakna a piapa in kha ahi hi. Sa in phattuamna a pia zo kei hi. Note kiangah kong thugenna in kha leh nuntakna ahi hi.
Ahih hangin note lakah a um lo mi kimkhat a om hi.

Tua ahih ciangin, ka Pa in thu a piak kei leh, kuamah kei kiangah hong pai thei kei hi kong ci hi,” a ci hi. Tua bang a cihna in bang hang hiam i cih leh, kua in um lo ding ahi zongin, kua in lehheek ding cih ahi zongin Zeisu in a cil panin a thei hi.
Tua-a kipanin ama nungzui tampite in Zeisu tawh kipawl nawn loin a kihei kik uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note zong paikhia ding na hi uh hiam?” ci-in sawm-le-nihte kiangah a dot ciangin,
Simon Piter in, “Topa aw, kote in kua kiangah pai ding ka hi uh hiam?
Nang in nuntak tawntungna thu na nei hi. Nangmah in Pasian’ misiangtho na hi ci-in kote in umin ka thei uh hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “sawm-le-nihte hong teel hilo ka hi hiam? Ahih hangin note lakah khat in dawi hilo ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua bang a cihna in, sawm-le-nihte lakah amah lehheek ding Simon Iskariot’ tapa Judas a cihnopna hi.
